name: Engram persistent memory
description: Memory persistence across Claude Code sessions via MCP server

externalTool.name: engram

install.linux: mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin" && arch=$(uname -m | sed -e s/x86_64/amd64/ -e s/aarch64/arm64/) && url=$(curl -fsSL https://api.github.com/repos/Gentleman-Programming/engram/releases/latest | grep -o "https://[^\"]*linux_${arch}\.tar\.gz" | head -1) && if [ -z "$url" ]; then echo "engram: no se pudo resolver el asset linux_${arch} del release (GitHub API rate-limited o asset ausente). Instala manualmente: https://github.com/Gentleman-Programming/engram/releases" >&2; exit 1; fi && curl -fsSL "$url" | tar -xz -C "$HOME/.local/bin" engram

externalTool.postInstall: claude plugin marketplace add Gentleman-Programming/engram && claude plugin install engram
